cues.en: Hi there. In this video, I'm going to be demonstrating Emacs' Org Mode, specifically how to use it with Org Babble to create technical documents like essays, blog posts, and how to guides.
cues.zh: 大家好。在这段视频中，我将演示 Emacs 的 Org Mode，具体是展示如何将其与 Org Babble 配合使用，来创建诸如文章、博客和操作指南之类的技术文档。

cues.en: When writing about programming or other technical subjects, you're often weaving blocks of source code, program output, and raw data in with your prose.
cues.zh: 在撰写编程或其他技术主题时，你经常需要将源代码块、程序输出和原始数据穿插在散文正文中。

cues.en: These supplementary materials are usually copied and pasted into your document from other sources,
cues.zh: 这些补充材料通常是从其他地方复制并粘贴到文档中的，

cues.en: which can be difficult and tedious to keep up to date as things change.
cues.zh: 当内容发生变化时，要保持它们的最新状态会变得困难且繁琐。

cues.en: Inconsistencies
cues.zh: 不一致性

cues.en: and errors can easily creep in when you hard code dynamic information like program output into your writing.
cues.zh: 以及各种错误很容易悄悄溜进来，特别是当你把程序输出这类动态信息硬编码到文章中时。

cues.en: In this example, we're going to be writing a blog post on how to manually create Git objects using Git plumbing commands on Python.
cues.zh: 在这个示例中，我们将撰写一篇博客文章，内容是如何在 Python 中使用 Git底层命令（plumbing commands）手动创建 Git 对象。

cues.en: I chose this example because there's lots of dynamic content like strings and SHA one hashes to contend with.
cues.zh: 我之所以选择这个示例，是因为里面有大量诸如字符串和 SHA-1 哈希之类的动态内容需要处理。

cues.en: I'm using GNU Emacs 26 dot three in a terminal frame inside of TMux.
cues.zh: 我使用的是运行在 TMux 终端窗口中的 GNU Emacs 26.3。

cues.en: I also use GUI frames, which can look pretty great in org with the same underlying server process,
cues.zh: 我也会使用图形界面（GUI）窗口，在使用相同的底层服务进程时，它在 Org 中看起来非常棒，

cues.en: which I'll show towards the end of the video.
cues.zh: 这一点我会在视频接近尾声时展示。

cues.en: If you don't know what Org Mode is, you can think of it as an enhanced markdown language.
cues.zh: 如果你不知道 Org Mode 是什么，你可以把它想象成一个增强版的 Markdown 语言。

cues.en: It's a plain text formatting syntax that is designed to be converted to a much fancier format,
cues.zh: 它是一种纯文本格式语法，旨在被转换为更华丽的格式，

cues.en: like HTML or PDF.
cues.zh: 比如 HTML 或 PDF。

cues.en: You've probably used a markdown language, maybe without even knowing it, when creating read me files for GitHub or GitLab or composed a message on an online discussion forum like Reddit.
cues.zh: 你可能已经用过 Markdown 语言，也许甚至在不知情的情况下用过，比如为 GitHub 或 GitLab 创建 README 文件，或者在 Reddit 等在线讨论论坛上编写消息。

cues.en: When we say org mode, we mean that Emacs is in a mode where it knows you're editing a file in the org markdown language.
cues.zh: 当我们说 org mode 时，指的是 Emacs 处于一种模式，它知道你正在编辑一个 org 标记语言的文本文件。

cues.en: This mode assists you by automatically rendering it in your buffer as well as giving you some key commands to easily manipulate the structure of your document.
cues.zh: 这个模式会通过自动在你的缓冲区中渲染它来帮助你，并给你一些快捷键来轻松操作文档的结构。

cues.en: If you look at your Org Mode file outside of Emacs, you can see what the plain text un rendered format looks like.
cues.zh: 如果你在 Emacs 之外查看你的 Org Mode 文件，你可以看到未渲染的纯文本格式是什么样的。

cues.en: I mentioned earlier that Markdown is designed to be converted to other formats.
cues.zh: 我之前提到过，Markdown 的设计目标是转换为其他格式。

cues.en: Let's see what it looks like when you export org to HTML.
cues.zh: 让我们看看把 org 导出为 HTML 后会是什么样子。

cues.en: Oh, nineteen ninety four called. They want their website back.
cues.zh: 哦，1994 年打来电话了。他们想要回他们的网站。

cues.en: Not to worry though. You can add some of that good old web two point o stuff like CSS, fonts, and JavaScript.
cues.zh: 不过别担心。你可以加入一些那种老派的 Web 2.0 元素，比如 CSS、字体和 JavaScript。

cues.en: I've set up the stuff in a file that will tell Org to load and parse when exporting our document.
cues.zh: 我已经在一个文件里设置好了这些东西，它会告诉 Org 在导出文档时加载和解析。

cues.en: The setup file directive can reference a URL or a file.
cues.zh: setup file 指令可以引用一个 URL 或一个文件。

cues.en: This file has a bunch of HTML head directives
cues.zh: 这个文件包含一堆 HTML head 指令

cues.en: that tell the HTML exporter to include local copies of JavaScript packages
cues.zh: 告诉 HTML 导出器包含 JavaScript 包的本地副本

cues.en: like jQuery and Twitter Bootstrap,
cues.zh: 比如 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap，

cues.en: as well as some CSS that implements this really cool read the docs inspired org theme called read the org by Fabrice Diesen.
cues.zh: 以及一些 CSS，实现了这个非常酷的、受 read the docs 启发的 org 主题，叫做 read the org，作者是 Fabrice Diesen。

cues.en: Now that we've configured the setup file, let's regenerate the HTML.
cues.zh: 现在我们已经配置好了 setup file，让我们重新生成 HTML。

cues.en: Oh, yeah. That looks a lot better.
cues.zh: 哦，是的。看起来好多了。

cues.en: Now that that is sorted out, let's get back to our essay.
cues.zh: 既然这个问题解决了，让我们回到我们的文章。

cues.en: In this section of the git essay we're writing, we want to demonstrate how you can manually do the work of git init by creating the dot git directory and the stuff that needs to go inside it.
cues.zh: 在我们正在写的这篇 git 文章的这一节中，我们想演示如何通过创建 .git 目录以及需要放在里面的内容，来手动完成 git init 的工作。

cues.en: Org has this thing called Org Babble that lets you run blocks of code inside of your document.
cues.zh: Org 有个叫 Org Babble 的功能，可以让你在文档里运行代码块。

cues.en: You create these blocks with the begin source directive.
cues.zh: 你可以用 begin source 指令来创建这些代码块。

cues.en: In this demo, we're going to be using both shell and Python blocks.
cues.zh: 在这个演示中，我们会同时用到 shell 和 Python 代码块。

cues.en: Now when it comes to shell blocks, it's a good idea to know some details about the environment that the shell code runs in. Things like your current working directory are sort of important.
cues.zh: 说到 shell 代码块，最好先了解 shell 代码运行环境的一些细节。比如当前工作目录就挺重要的。

cues.en: I created a shell source block with a couple of commands in it, and I told Org to execute it. Org then wrote the output of those commands into my buffer below the source block.
cues.zh: 我创建了一个 shell 源码块，里面有几条命令，然后让 Org 执行它。Org 就把这些命令的输出写到了源码块下方的缓冲区里。

cues.en: By default, your current working directory is going to be the same directory that the org file you're editing is in.
cues.zh: 默认情况下，你的当前工作目录就是正在编辑的 org 文件所在的目录。

cues.en: You can also see that when we exported our git dot org file to HTML,
cues.zh: 你还可以看到，当我们把 git 点 org 文件导出为 HTML 时，

cues.en: org wrote git dot HTML to the same directory.
cues.zh: org 把 git 点 HTML 写到了同一个目录下。

cues.en: This directory is not gonna work for us. We want our code blocks to execute in a temporary directory that gets cleaned out every time we export the document.
cues.zh: 这个目录对我们来说不行。我们希望代码块在一个临时目录里执行，每次导出文档时都把它清理掉。

cues.en: We can add these things called header args to our source blocks to tell org details about how we want these blocks executed.
cues.zh: 我们可以给源码块加上所谓的 header args，告诉 org 我们希望这些块怎么执行。

cues.en: Here, we use the dir header arg to point us at a scratch directory.
cues.zh: 这里我们用 dir 这个 header arg 指向一个临时目录。

cues.en: Now
cues.zh: 现在

cues.en: when we execute this block, it sets our directory to home org temp.
cues.zh: 当我们执行这个块时，它会把目录设为 home org temp。

cues.en: We don't wanna have to remember to set this header arg on every source block though, so we'll create a global property that applies to every source block in this buffer.
cues.zh: 不过我们不想每个源码块都记着去设这个 header arg，所以我们要创建一个全局属性，让它作用于这个缓冲区里的每个源码块。

cues.en: Now when we reevaluate
cues.zh: 现在我们重新评估

cues.en: this block, we're in the right directory even though we didn't explicitly set it as a header arg on the block.
cues.zh: 这个代码块时，我们已经处于正确的目录中，尽管我们并没有在代码块上显式地把这个目录设置为 header arg。

cues.en: Remember when I said that we wanted to clean out the directory every time we export this document? Let's do that now.
cues.zh: 还记得我说过，每次导出这个文档时，我们都想清空目录吗？现在就来这么做。

cues.en: We're going to tell Orb to include a file called code dot inc where we'll stash some utility functions that we'll use later in this document.
cues.zh: 我们要告诉 Orb 包含一个名为 code dot inc 的文件，里面会放一些稍后在这个文档中要用的工具函数。

cues.en: This tag tells Emacs to load Org mode when it opens this file even though it doesn't end in dot org.
cues.zh: 这个标签告诉 Emacs 在打开这个文件时加载 Org mode，即使它的文件名并不以 dot org 结尾。

cues.en: The name directive above the begin source block allows you to give the code block a name, which will be necessary to refer to it later.
cues.zh: begin source block 上面的 name 指令允许你给代码块起个名字，之后引用它时会用到。

cues.en: And this exports none header arg tells Org that we don't want to see this code block or its results show up in the export of our document, but we do want it to execute.
cues.zh: 而这个 exports none header arg 告诉 Org，我们不希望这个代码块或它的结果显示在文档导出中，但我们确实希望它执行。

cues.en: Because our git tutorial depends on starting without a dot git directory,
cues.zh: 因为我们的 git 教程依赖于一开始没有 dot git 目录，

cues.en: then creating one, and then adding an object to it, we'll need to blow away the junk that previous exports of our documents right to the temp directory.
cues.zh: 然后创建一个，再往里面添加一个对象，所以我们需要清掉之前导出文档时留在临时目录里的垃圾。

cues.en: This way we start fresh.
cues.zh: 这样我们就能从干净状态开始。

cues.en: This call directive at the top of the file tells Org to invoke the function that we just created to do that.
cues.zh: 文件顶部的这个 call 指令告诉 Org 调用我们刚创建的函数来完成这件事。

cues.en: Alright. Back to our git tutorial.
cues.zh: 好，回到我们的 git 教程。

cues.en: We're gonna run git status to show that in the current state of the world, git is not happy because it doesn't have a dot git dir. When we run git status here,
cues.zh: 我们会运行 git status 来展示当前状态下 git 并不满意，因为它没有 dot git 目录。当我们在这里运行 git status 时，

cues.en: notice how we redirect standard error to standard out. This is because org babble doesn't really capture standard error. And if you wanna demonstrate what an error message looks like, this is what you have to do.
cues.zh: 注意我们如何把标准错误重定向到标准输出。这是因为 org babble 并不能真正捕获标准错误。如果你想演示错误消息长什么样，就只能这么做。

cues.en: This is the part of the essay where we show how to initialize a Git repo by hand.
cues.zh: 这篇演讲要展示的是如何手动初始化一个 Git 仓库。

cues.en: I watched a YouTube video of this great talk that Tim Berglund gave back in 2013
cues.zh: 我看过一个 YouTube 视频，是 Tim Berglund 在 2013 年做的一场精彩演讲

cues.en: called
cues.zh: 演讲题目叫

cues.en: Git from the Bits Up. If you haven't seen it, I'd highly recommend watching it. My fake essay here shamelessly rips off his awesome talk.
cues.zh: Git from the Bits Up。如果你还没看过，我强烈推荐去看。我这里的这篇假文章毫不客气地照搬了他那场精彩的演讲。

cues.en: Now we create another shell source block where we create a bunch of directories, add the head ref, run tree to show the tree, and then run git status to prove that git is happy. Both the tree command and the git status command add output to the result blocks. If you were to try this for yourself, you might be surprised to discover that in your version of Emacs, only the very last line of the shell block is outputted.
cues.zh: 现在我们再创建一个 shell 源码块，在其中创建一堆目录、添加 head ref、运行 tree 显示目录树，然后运行 git status 证明 git 正常。tree 命令和 git status 命令都会把输出加到结果块里。如果你自己试一下，可能会惊讶地发现，在你的 Emacs 版本里，只会输出 shell 块的最后一行。

cues.en: This is because by default,
cues.zh: 这是因为默认情况下，

cues.en: org is in value mode where the return value of the block you're executing is the result. In my Emacs config, I changed this default to scripting mode where the results are anything written to standard out.
cues.zh: org 处于 value 模式，也就是所执行块的返回值即为结果。在我的 Emacs 配置里，我把这个默认值改成了 scripting 模式，结果就是写入标准输出的所有内容。

cues.en: Let's get rid of some old browser tabs and then export again to HTML to see what we're working with.
cues.zh: 我们关掉一些旧的浏览器标签页，然后再导出一次 HTML，看看效果。

cues.en: Let me just add a quick note about what git needs to be happy, and now we're gonna move on to the next section of the document.
cues.zh: 我先简单补一句 git 正常需要什么，然后我们就进入文档的下一节。

cues.en: This is where we show how you can hash an arbitrary string and store in the git object database.
cues.zh: 这一节展示如何对任意字符串做哈希，并存入 git 对象数据库。

cues.en: Now my first impulse is that that string should be hello world. And then I thought, maybe it should be something like welcome to Seagull two thousand nineteen,
cues.zh: 我的第一反应是这个字符串应该是 hello world。然后我又想，也许应该是类似 welcome to Seagull two thousand nineteen 这样的内容，

cues.en: which is the conference I'm giving this talk at. And then I thought, you know, it should be dynamic so I can change it to whatever I want. So let's do that.
cues.zh: 也就是我正在做这场演讲的会议。接着我又想，你知道，它应该是动态的，这样我就能改成任何我想要的内容。那就这么办吧。

cues.en: Now we're back in the code dot inc file where we're going to keep all the little utility functions that we use throughout the document.
cues.zh: 现在我们回到了 code.inc 文件，这里用来存放整个文档中要用到的各种小工具函数。

cues.en: We're gonna name this function hello, and its job is to just output whatever string we're using for our hash example.
cues.zh: 我们把这个函数命名为 hello，它的作用就是输出哈希示例中用到的字符串。

cues.en: To mix things up a bit, we're gonna do this example in Python.
cues.zh: 为了换换口味，这次示例我们用 Python 来实现。

cues.en: Under the hood, there's a Python three virtual environment that the script is running in, and that end equals quote quote at the end of the print line is just to tell print not to output a trailing new line.
cues.zh: 在底层，脚本运行在一个 Python 3 虚拟环境中，而 print 末尾的 end="" 只是告诉 print 不要输出结尾的换行符。

cues.en: Let's save it, flip back to our document, and then replace the hard coded text hello world with an inline call to the hello function.
cues.zh: 保存一下，切回我们的文档，把硬编码的“hello world”文本替换成对 hello 函数的内联调用。

cues.en: Did it work? Let's export it to HTML and see what it looks like.
cues.zh: 起作用了吗？我们导出成 HTML 看看效果。

cues.en: By default, org renders the output of inline functions in monospace,
cues.zh: 默认情况下，Org 会将内联函数的输出渲染为等宽字体，

cues.en: which I don't think looks very good here. We can fix it by adding a header tag to our function invocation.
cues.zh: 我觉得在这里看着不太美观。我们可以给函数调用加个 header 标签来搞定。

cues.en: There we go. Much better.
cues.zh: 这就对了，好多了。

cues.en: Now we're going to create a new source block and we're gonna name it hash object.
cues.zh: 现在我们要新建一个源码块，并把它命名为 hash object。

cues.en: This allows us to refer to the results of this block by name, which we're gonna do later. Instead of echoing the literal hello world string,
cues.zh: 这样稍后我们就能按名称引用这个块的结果了。这次我们不再直接输出字面量字符串“hello world”，

cues.en: I have what looks like a function invocation surrounded by a pair of double angle brackets.
cues.zh: 而是用了一对双尖括号，包着一个看似函数调用的写法。

cues.en: This is what's called the no web method.
cues.zh: 这就是所谓的 noweb 方法。

cues.en: And when we execute it, the results are now tagged by name.
cues.zh: 执行之后，输出结果现在就带上了名称标记。

cues.en: Here, I paste in some verbiage about the GitSha.
cues.zh: 这里我粘贴一些关于 GitSha 的说明。

cues.en: And at this point, I want to mention that you don't always have to refer to the entire 40 character hash, and that you can often use as few as four characters to uniquely identify it.
cues.zh: 到这里，我想提一下，你不一定总要引用完整的 40 个字符的哈希值，通常用四个字符就足以唯一标识它。

cues.en: Here I'm at a dilemma. I want to hard code o five d five into my document, which are the first four characters of the hash in this example.
cues.zh: 这里我有点为难。我想把 o five d five 硬编码到文档中，这是本例中哈希值的前四个字符。

cues.en: But if I change the hello string, I change the hash, and then my document is wrong if I forget to update all the hash references.
cues.zh: 但如果我改了 hello 字符串，哈希值就变了，然后如果我忘了更新所有哈希引用，文档就错了。

cues.en: Another inline function to the rescue.
cues.zh: 又一个内联函数来救场。

cues.en: We'll define a function named short hash, and this time we'll add the var tag to specify that this function takes a variable named line as an argument. And we'll provide a default because that's useful for testing.
cues.zh: 我们定义一个名为 short hash 的函数，这次加上 var 标签，指定这个函数接受一个名为 line 的变量作为参数。我们会提供一个默认值，因为这对测试很有用。

cues.en: If we hit control c control c to execute this block in the buffer, we can see that it uses the default, and it does indeed just output the first four characters of the line variable.
cues.zh: 如果我们按 Control-C Control-C 在缓冲区中执行这个代码块，可以看到它使用了默认值，而且确实只输出了 line 变量的前四个字符。

cues.en: Now we can just call this function inline and pass in the argument line equals hash object, which is the result of the named shell block we created above.
cues.zh: 现在我们可以直接内联调用这个函数，传入参数 line 等于 hash object，也就是我们上面创建的命名 shell 代码块的结果。

cues.en: Now we export it to HTML and take a look and see what it looks like.

cues.zh: 然后输出

cues.zh: 指向某个哈希，方便测试。这个脚本做的事是，用一个 Python 3 的 f 字符串，基本上就是
